title: formula: CEL has no string form for a Timestamp (`string(today())` has no overload), so #19939 cannot refuse `{NOW()}` / `{TODAY() ± N}` in flow value slots — the sub-card #11182's ruling D names
body:
Filing gate: **a prerequisite the ruling names, not a new finding.** #11182's ruling of record `5805777944` (letter D, maintainer 「11182 D 其他同意」) refuses the template dialect in flow value slots with per-spelling remedies, including "a string form for `NOW()` / `TODAY()`". #19939's body names the contingency: "the round measured that CEL yields a Timestamp and this engine has no `string(timestamp)` — a `packages/formula` sub-card if v18 needs it". v18 needs it, so this is that sub-card. It was filed by the `domain:spec` seat 3 (seat post #18883, `session_01RPo7FUd6bSnAfkWMAKi848`) at #19939 pass 1's landing. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## What is measured (by #19939's dev, pass 1, PR #22259)

- `now()`, `today()`, `daysFromNow(N)` and `addDays(today(), N)` in a flow value slot yield a Timestamp. It reaches the data engine as a `Date`; this was measured through ObjectQL with a recording driver.
- `{TODAY()}` in the template dialect writes ISO date text; `{NOW()}` writes ISO date-time text.
- `string(today())` is refused for want of an overload (probe D6 / X13 in the pass-1 report on #19939).
- So pass 1 (PR #22259 → `0e9e7b706`) deliberately **keeps** the date macros `{NOW()}`, `{TODAY()}` and `{TODAY() ± N}` in value slots. Their refusal has no remedy to name until CEL can spell the same value.

## What this card adds

A string form for a CEL Timestamp in `packages/formula`'s CEL environment: a `string(Timestamp)` overload, or a named date-text function. Either way it writes what the template wrote:
- ISO date text for a date (`{TODAY()}`);
- ISO date-time text for a date-time (`{NOW()}`).

Pin the two shapes. Pin that it is the same text `interpolateString` produces for the date macros today, over the same instants. Pin that no envelope that returns a Timestamp today changes what it writes, because this adds a spelling and changes no write path.

## Then

#19939's date-macro half refuses `{NOW()}` / `{TODAY() ± N}` with this spelling as the remedy. That card names this one as its prerequisite.

## Reader who acts

Triage grades and routes it. The landing site is `packages/formula`, so by the anchoring table it is `domain:engine`. It is graded with #19939 (`priority:p2`, `target:v18`).

Dedupe words: `string(Timestamp) overload CEL` · `date text function formula` · `TODAY() NOW() value slot remedy` · `#19939 date macros`
